children: Matador Resources retired Van H. Singleton, II as Co‑President and appointed Bryan A. Erman and Jonathan J. Filbert to assume his responsibilities, with Singleton transitioning to a Special Advisor role.
Former Co‑President – Land, Acquisitions and Divestitures and Planning; Special Advisor to the Board and Executive Committee
Co‑President; Chief Legal Officer and Head of M&A
Retired from Co‑President; transitioned to Special Advisor
Transition to advisory role; company thanked him for his service
Role assumed by Bryan A. Erman and responsibilities for land/M&A assumed by Jonathan J. Filbert

Entered Advisor Agreement with subsidiary to provide business development, acquisitions/divestitures and strategy services; annual fee $450,000; continued vesting of outstanding equity; confidentiality, non‑compete and non‑solicit covenants
Has served as Co‑President, Chief Legal Officer and Head of M&A since June 2025
Has served as Executive Vice President – Land since Oct 2023
Will serve as Special Advisor to the Board and Executive Committee
